goal: Prevent callers from forging fake log lines in debug.log using unescaped newlines in untrusted inputs
Protects node operators and automated monitoring tools from being misled by spoofed errors or statuses
agreement: Strong support for central newline escaping to prevent log forging across inputs (davidgumberg, ryanofsky)
Verified by testing RPC log injection prevention and wallet name handling (polespinasa)
Resolved objection: preserved intentional multiline logs by splitting them into separate entries (maflcko)
Resolved objection: dropped out-of-scope wallet name validation to focus purely on logging (ryanofsky)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes an issue where unescaped input newlines let restricted users forge log lines
Benefits node operators and monitoring tools by ensuring log messages cannot be spoofed
